question: would updating the pyJianYingDraft snapshot cover the 32 panel names that did not match?
method: git fetch in the reference checkout, then compare pyJianYingDraft/metadata/video_scene_effect.py between the pinned commit and FETCH_HEAD

result.verdict: the upstream metadata file is byte-for-byte the same size and still lacks the newer 11.7 effects, so refreshing the snapshot would not raise the name-to-id coverage

consequence: the remaining panel names can only be bound to ids through the application itself, and the application does not persist them where a script can read them (rp.db has zero rows after browsing, drafts are encrypted, cached media files are md5-named). The practical route stays: register witnessed ids with media harvest-enums add.
not_proven: that the byte size equality implies identical content - the file was compared by size and by a name sample, not by hash
whether a future upstream release will add the 11.7 effects
